onprem.title: Enterprise On-Premise
onprem.desc: Install DencPass on your own servers. Your data stays on-site, under your control.

footnote: Every plan includes AES-256-GCM encryption and HIBP k-anonymity checks.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. All our pricing is listed in CFA francs (XOF). No conversion, no exchange fees: what you see is what you pay.
faq.q2: What's the difference between Enterprise Cloud and On-Premise?
faq.a2: Enterprise Cloud is hosted and maintained by our team: you start immediately. Enterprise On-Premise deploys in your own datacenter (Docker or bare metal) for full control over your data.
faq.q3: Can I change plans at any time?
faq.a3: Yes, you can upgrade whenever you like. The change takes effect immediately, billed pro-rata.
faq.q4: Is there a discount for the annual plan?
faq.a4: Yes: the annual Pro plan comes down to 1,600 FCFA/month — a 20% discount compared to monthly billing.

cta.title: Have specific needs?
cta.subtitle: Our team is available for custom pricing and a demo.
